readings.text: It is a sunny day today. The sky is blue and there are no clouds. It is hot, about thirty degrees. Children are playing in the park. Some people are eating ice cream. I am wearing a T-shirt and a hat. Tomorrow it is rainy. I need a coat and an umbrella. It is a good day for the park. I can see my friends there. We can play football. I am happy.

questions.q: It is hot today.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "It is hot, about thirty degrees" → TRUE.

questions.q: There are many clouds in the sky today.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The sky is blue and there are no clouds" – hôm nay không có mây → FALSE.

questions.q: The writer has a dog.
questions.explain: Văn bản không đề cập người viết có nuôi chó hay không → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What are the children doing?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Children are playing in the park" – bọn trẻ đang chơi trong công viên → đáp án đúng: Playing in the park.

questions.q: What does the writer need tomorrow?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Tomorrow it is rainy. I need a coat and an umbrella" – ngày mai cần áo khoác và ô → đáp án đúng: A coat and an umbrella.

questions.q: The writer is wearing a hat.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I am wearing a T-shirt and a hat" → TRUE.

questions.q: What are some people eating?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Some people are eating ice cream" – một số người đang ăn kem → đáp án đúng: Ice cream.

questions.q: What is the weather like tomorrow?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Tomorrow it is rainy" – ngày mai trời mưa → đáp án đúng: Rainy.

readings.title: My School Day
readings.summaryVi: Một bạn học sinh kể về ngày đi học của mình: đi bộ đến trường, học các môn, ăn trưa và chơi bóng đá.
readings.summaryEn: A student describes a school day: walking to school, lessons, lunch and playing football.
readings.text:
I go to school at eight o'clock. My school is near my house. I walk with my friend Lan.

We have four lessons in the morning. My favourite lesson is English. At twelve o'clock, we eat lunch in the school room. I have rice and fish.

In the afternoon, we have two more lessons. Then we play football in the yard. I go home at four o'clock. I like my school day. It is a good day.

questions.q: The writer walks to school with a friend.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I walk with my friend Lan" → TRUE.

questions.q: There are six lessons in the morning.
questions.explain: Bài viết nói: "We have four lessons in the morning", không phải sáu bài → FALSE.

questions.q: Lan likes English too.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói môn yêu thích của người viết là tiếng Anh, không đề cập Lan có thích tiếng Anh hay không → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What is the writer's favourite lesson?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My favourite lesson is English" → đáp án đúng: English.

questions.q: When does the writer go home?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I go home at four o'clock" → đáp án đúng: At four o'clock.

questions.q: The writer plays football in the morning.
questions.explain: Bài viết nói: "In the afternoon, we have two more lessons. Then we play football in the yard" → chơi bóng buổi chiều, không phải buổi sáng → FALSE.

questions.q: How many lessons are there in the afternoon?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "In the afternoon, we have two more lessons" → đáp án đúng: Two.

questions.q: Where is the writer's school?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My school is near my house" → đáp án đúng: Near his house.

readings.title: A Day at the Beach
readings.summaryVi: Một gia đình có một ngày vui ở bãi biển: bơi, đọc sách, xây nhà cát và ăn kem.
readings.summaryEn: A family enjoys a day at the beach: swimming, reading, building a sand house and eating ice cream.
readings.text:
It is a hot, sunny day. We are at the beach. The sea is blue and warm. The sand is hot.

My brother is swimming. My mother is sitting under a big umbrella. She is reading a book. I am making a sand house.

There are many people on the beach. Some children are playing with a ball. My father is buying ice cream for us. We are very happy today. I love the sea.

questions.q: The writer's brother is swimming.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My brother is swimming" → TRUE.

questions.q: The writer's mother is swimming in the sea.
questions.explain: Bài viết nói mẹ đang ngồi dưới ô lớn và đọc sách: "My mother is sitting under a big umbrella. She is reading a book" → FALSE.

questions.q: The beach is far from the writer's house.
questions.explain: Bài không nói bãi biển gần hay xa nhà người viết → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What is the writer making?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I am making a sand house" → đáp án đúng: A sand house.

questions.q: What is the writer's father doing?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My father is buying ice cream for us" → đáp án đúng: Buying ice cream.

questions.q: Some children are playing with a ball.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Some children are playing with a ball" → TRUE.

questions.q: What is the weather like?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "It is a hot, sunny day" → đáp án đúng: Hot and sunny.

questions.q: What is the sea like?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The sea is blue and warm" → đáp án đúng: Blue and warm.

readings.title: My Best Friend
readings.summaryVi: Người viết giới thiệu người bạn thân Nam: ngoại hình, tính cách, tài năng và những việc họ làm cùng nhau.
readings.summaryEn: The writer introduces his best friend Nam: his looks, personality, talents and what they do together.
readings.text:
My best friend is Nam. He is twelve years old. He is tall and he has short black hair. He is kind and funny. Everyone likes him.

We are in the same class. Nam can play the guitar. He can also sing very well.

After school, we do our homework together. At the weekend, we play games. I like Nam because he is always happy. He is a good friend.

questions.q: Nam can play the guitar.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Nam can play the guitar" → TRUE.

questions.q: Nam has long hair.
questions.explain: Bài viết nói Nam có tóc đen ngắn: "he has short black hair" → FALSE.

questions.q: Nam has a brother.
questions.explain: Bài không nhắc gì đến anh em của Nam → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: How old is Nam?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "He is twelve years old" → đáp án đúng: Twelve.

questions.q: When do the two friends play games?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "At the weekend, we play games" → đáp án đúng: At the weekend.

questions.q: Nam and the writer are in the same class.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "We are in the same class" → TRUE.

questions.q: What is Nam like?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "He is kind and funny" → đáp án đúng: Kind and funny.

questions.q: What else can Nam do very well?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "He can also sing very well" → đáp án đúng: Sing.

readings.title: In the Kitchen
readings.summaryVi: Người viết tả căn bếp nhỏ của gia đình và giúp mẹ nấu bữa tối.
readings.summaryEn: The writer describes the family kitchen and helps his mother cook dinner.
readings.text:
This is my kitchen. It is small, but it is clean. I like it. There is a table and four chairs. There is a big fridge near the door.

My mother is cooking dinner now. She is making soup. There are some eggs and vegetables on the table. I am helping her. I wash the vegetables.

My father is not here. He is at work. We eat dinner at six o'clock. I love my family.

questions.q: There are four chairs in the kitchen.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There is a table and four chairs" → TRUE.

questions.q: The writer's father is cooking dinner.
questions.explain: Bài viết nói mẹ đang nấu ăn: "My mother is cooking dinner now", còn bố đang đi làm: "He is at work" → FALSE.

questions.q: The writer's mother works in a hospital.
questions.explain: Bài không nói mẹ làm nghề gì hay làm ở đâu → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What is the writer doing?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I am helping her. I wash the vegetables" → đáp án đúng: Washing vegetables.

questions.q: Where is the big fridge?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There is a big fridge near the door" → đáp án đúng: Near the door.

questions.q: The family has a dog.
questions.explain: Bài không nhắc gì đến con chó hay thú nuôi nào trong nhà → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What is on the table?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There are some eggs and vegetables on the table" → đáp án đúng: Eggs and vegetables.

questions.q: When does the family eat dinner?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "We eat dinner at six o'clock" → đáp án đúng: At six o'clock.

readings.title: My Bedroom
readings.summaryVi: Một bạn nhỏ tả phòng ngủ của mình: có giường, bàn học, đèn, tranh và một chiếc ghế đỏ để đọc sách.
readings.summaryEn: A young person describes a small bedroom with a bed, a desk, a lamp, pictures and a red chair for reading.
readings.text: This is my bedroom. It is small, but I like it. There is a bed next to the window. The bed is blue. There is a desk near the door. On the desk, there is a lamp and some books. I do my homework at the desk every evening. There are two pictures on the wall. There is a big red chair in the corner. I read books on the chair. I sleep well in my bedroom.

questions.q: The bed is next to the window.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There is a bed next to the window" → TRUE.

questions.q: The desk is near the window.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There is a desk near the door" – bàn học ở gần cửa ra vào, không phải cửa sổ → FALSE.

questions.q: There is a computer on the desk.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói trên bàn có đèn và sách, không nhắc đến máy tính → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: Where does the writer read books?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I read books on the chair" → đọc sách trên ghế.

questions.q: What colour is the bed?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The bed is blue" → giường màu xanh dương (chiếc ghế mới là màu đỏ).

questions.q: There are two pictures on the wall.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There are two pictures on the wall" → TRUE.

questions.q: Where is the lamp?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "On the desk, there is a lamp and some books" → đèn ở trên bàn học.

questions.q: When does the writer do homework?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I do my homework at the desk every evening" → làm bài tập mỗi buổi tối.

readings.title: A Birthday Party
readings.summaryVi: Hôm nay là sinh nhật em gái người kể: có bánh, bóng bay, pizza, trò chơi và quà.
readings.summaryEn: Today is the writer's sister's birthday: there is a cake, balloons, pizza, games and presents.
readings.text: Today is my sister's birthday. She is ten years old. Our friends are at our house. There is a big cake on the table. It has ten candles. My mother is in the kitchen. She makes pizza for everyone. My father puts balloons on the wall. The children play games in the garden. My sister opens her presents. She is very happy. We sing a birthday song. Then we eat the cake together.

questions.q: There is a big cake on the table.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There is a big cake on the table" → TRUE.

questions.q: The mother is in the garden.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My mother is in the kitchen" – mẹ ở trong bếp, còn bọn trẻ mới chơi ở vườn → FALSE.

questions.q: The sister gets a new bicycle.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói cô bé mở quà ("opens her presents"), không nói đó là xe đạp → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What does the mother make?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "She makes pizza for everyone" → mẹ làm pizza.

questions.q: Who puts balloons on the wall?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My father puts balloons on the wall" → bố treo bóng bay.

questions.q: The cake has ten candles.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "It has ten candles" → bánh có mười cây nến → TRUE.

questions.q: Where do the children play games?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The children play games in the garden" → bọn trẻ chơi ở trong vườn.

questions.q: What do they do after the birthday song?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "We sing a birthday song. Then we eat the cake together" → sau bài hát họ cùng ăn bánh.

readings.title: At the Doctor
readings.summaryVi: Anna bị đau đầu và đau họng, đến gặp bác sĩ; bác sĩ nói cô bị cảm và cho thuốc.
readings.summaryEn: Anna has a headache and a sore throat; the doctor says she has a cold and gives her medicine.
readings.text: Anna is at the doctor's today. She has a headache and a sore throat. The doctor is a kind woman. She looks at Anna's throat. She says, "You have a cold." Anna must stay at home. She must drink warm water and rest. The doctor gives her some medicine. Anna takes it three times a day. She says thank you and goes home. The doctor says she can go to school in two days.

questions.q: Anna has a sore throat.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "She has a headache and a sore throat" → TRUE.

questions.q: The doctor is a man.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The doctor is a kind woman" – bác sĩ là phụ nữ → FALSE.

questions.q: Anna's mother goes to the doctor with her.
questions.explain: Bài không nhắc đến mẹ của Anna hay ai đi cùng cô → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What does the doctor say Anna has?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "You have a cold" → bác sĩ nói Anna bị cảm.

questions.q: How often does Anna take the medicine?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Anna takes it three times a day" → uống ba lần một ngày.

questions.q: Anna has a fever.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói Anna đau đầu, đau họng và bị cảm ("a headache and a sore throat"), không nhắc đến sốt → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What must Anna drink?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "She must drink warm water and rest" → Anna phải uống nước ấm.

questions.q: When can Anna go to school?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The doctor says she can go to school in two days" → hai ngày nữa Anna có thể đi học.

readings.title: My Pet Dog
readings.summaryVi: Người kể giới thiệu chú chó Max: màu nâu trắng, thích chạy ở công viên, chơi bóng và ngủ trong bếp.
readings.summaryEn: The writer introduces a dog called Max: brown and white, he likes running in the park, playing with a ball and sleeping in the kitchen.
readings.text: I have a dog. His name is Max. He is two years old. Max is brown and white. He has big ears and a long tail. He likes to run in the park. He also likes to play with a ball. Every morning I give him food and water. In the evening, we go for a walk. Max sleeps in a small bed in the kitchen. I love my dog very much.

questions.q: Max is two years old.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "He is two years old" → TRUE.

questions.q: Max sleeps in the garden.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Max sleeps in a small bed in the kitchen" – Max ngủ trong bếp → FALSE.

questions.q: Max can swim.
questions.explain: Bài không nhắc đến việc Max biết bơi → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What does Max like to play with?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "He also likes to play with a ball" → Max thích chơi với quả bóng.

questions.q: Where does Max like to run?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "He likes to run in the park" → Max thích chạy ở công viên.

questions.q: Max has small ears.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "He has big ears and a long tail" – tai Max to, không nhỏ → FALSE.

questions.q: What does the writer give Max every morning?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "Every morning I give him food and water" → sáng nào cũng cho Max ăn và uống (đi dạo là vào buổi tối).

questions.q: What is Max's tail like?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "He has big ears and a long tail" → đuôi của Max dài.

readings.title: My Town
readings.summaryVi: Một người giới thiệu thị trấn nhỏ, yên tĩnh và sạch sẽ của mình với công viên, trường học, cửa hàng và trạm xe buýt.
readings.summaryEn: A person describes a small, quiet and clean town with a park, a school, shops and a bus station.
readings.text:
I live in a small town. There is a big park in the centre. There are many trees and flowers in it. There is a school near the park.

My mother works in a shop on Main Street. There are two banks and a post office too. There is no airport, but there is a bus station.

People in my town are friendly. I like my town because it is quiet and clean.

questions.q: There is a big park in the centre of the town.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There is a big park in the centre" → TRUE.

questions.q: There is an airport in the town.
questions.explain: Bài viết nói: "There is no airport, but there is a bus station" → không có sân bay → FALSE.

questions.q: The writer's father works in a bank.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói mẹ làm việc ở một cửa hàng; bài không nhắc đến bố hay nghề của bố → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: Where does the writer's mother work?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My mother works in a shop on Main Street" → mẹ làm ở một cửa hàng.

questions.q: Why does the writer like the town?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I like my town because it is quiet and clean" → yên tĩnh và sạch sẽ.

questions.q: There are three banks in the town.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There are two banks and a post office too" → có hai ngân hàng, không phải ba → FALSE.

questions.q: What is near the park?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "There is a school near the park" → trường học ở gần công viên.

questions.q: In the text, "friendly" means
questions.explain: Bài viết: "People in my town are friendly" → người dân thân thiện, tức là tử tế với người khác.

readings.title: A Train Trip
readings.summaryVi: Một người đang đi tàu ra biển, ngồi cạnh cửa sổ, ngắm cánh đồng xanh và mong được nhìn thấy biển.
readings.summaryEn: A person is on a train to the coast, sits by the window, sees green fields and is excited to see the sea.
readings.text:
Today I am on a train to the coast. The train is fast and clean. I have a window seat. I can see green fields and small houses.

A woman sits next to me. She is reading a book. A man sells tea and cakes. The ticket is cheap, only ten pounds. The journey takes two hours. The train stops at three stations.

I am happy because I want to see the sea.

questions.q: The writer has a window seat.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I have a window seat" → TRUE.

questions.q: The ticket is expensive.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The ticket is cheap, only ten pounds" → vé rẻ, không đắt → FALSE.

questions.q: The woman next to the writer is a teacher.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói người phụ nữ đang đọc sách; bài không nhắc đến nghề nghiệp của bà → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What can the writer see from the window?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I can see green fields and small houses" → đáp án đúng: Green fields and small houses.

questions.q: Why is the writer happy?
options: The seat is next to a friend.
The writer wants to see the sea.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I am happy because I want to see the sea" → vì muốn nhìn thấy biển.

questions.q: The train stops at three stations.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The train stops at three stations" → TRUE.

questions.q: How long is the journey?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "The journey takes two hours" → hành trình mất hai giờ.

questions.q: What does the man on the train sell?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "A man sells tea and cakes" → bán trà và bánh.

readings.title: My Favourite Food
readings.summaryVi: Một người kể về món cơm gà yêu thích do bà nấu mỗi Chủ nhật và cả nhà cùng ăn.
readings.summaryEn: A person talks about a favourite dish of rice and chicken that their grandmother cooks every Sunday for the family.
readings.text:
My favourite food is rice with chicken. My grandmother cooks it every Sunday. She uses garlic, onions and a little salt. The smell is very good.

We sit at a big table. I eat it with fresh vegetables. I also drink a glass of water. My brother does not like chicken, so he eats fish. After lunch, we have fruit.

I think home food is the best food. It is healthy and it makes everyone happy.

questions.q: The writer's grandmother cooks the dish every Sunday.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My grandmother cooks it every Sunday" → TRUE.

questions.q: The writer's brother likes chicken.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My brother does not like chicken, so he eats fish" → em/anh không thích gà → FALSE.

questions.q: The writer learns to cook from his grandmother.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói bà nấu món ăn; bài không nhắc đến việc người viết học nấu ăn → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What does the grandmother use in the dish?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "She uses garlic, onions and a little salt" → tỏi và hành.

questions.q: What does the writer's brother eat?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "My brother does not like chicken, so he eats fish" → ăn cá.

questions.q: The writer drinks water with the meal.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I also drink a glass of water" → TRUE.

questions.q: What does the family have after lunch?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "After lunch, we have fruit" → ăn trái cây sau bữa trưa.

questions.q: Why does the writer think home food is the best?
options: It has a lot of salt.
It is healthy and makes everyone happy.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "It is healthy and it makes everyone happy" → tốt cho sức khỏe và làm mọi người vui.

readings.title: My Weekend
readings.summaryVi: Một người kể về cuối tuần của mình: đá bóng, dọn phòng, xem phim và thăm ông bà.
readings.summaryEn: A person describes their weekend: playing football, cleaning, watching a film and visiting grandparents.
readings.text:
I like my weekend. On Saturday morning, I play football with my friends. In the afternoon, I clean my room and do my homework. In the evening, we watch a film at home.

On Sunday, I visit my grandparents. We have lunch together and talk. Then I walk home. At night, I read a book and go to bed early.

I am tired on Monday, but I am happy.

questions.q: The writer plays football on Saturday morning.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "On Saturday morning, I play football with my friends" → TRUE.

questions.q: The writer visits his grandparents on Saturday.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "On Sunday, I visit my grandparents" → đi thăm ông bà vào Chủ nhật, không phải thứ Bảy → FALSE.

questions.q: The writer's friends play football very well.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói người viết chơi bóng với bạn; bài không nhắc đến việc các bạn chơi giỏi hay không → NOT GIVEN.

questions.q: What does the writer do on Saturday afternoon?
options: Cleans the room and does homework
questions.explain: Bài viết: "In the afternoon, I clean my room and do my homework".

questions.q: What does the writer do at night?
options: Reads a book and goes to bed early
questions.explain: Bài viết: "At night, I read a book and go to bed early" → đáp án đúng: Reads a book and goes to bed early.

questions.q: The writer goes to bed late at night.
questions.explain: Bài viết: "At night, I read a book and go to bed early" → đi ngủ sớm, không phải muộn → FALSE.

questions.q: Who does the writer visit on Sunday?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "On Sunday, I visit my grandparents" → thăm ông bà.

questions.q: How does the writer feel on Monday?
questions.explain: Bài viết: "I am tired on Monday, but I am happy" → mệt nhưng vui.
